name: aquariuslang-tw
description: Traditional Chinese Aquarius language support: highlighting, snippets, diagnostics, completion, hover, and definitions.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Syntax highlighting and snippets are available. The language server starts after trusting the workspace.

aquarius.dotnetPath.description: Path to the .NET executable used to run the language server. Requires .NET 8 runtime or newer (major-version roll-forward enabled).

aquarius.serverPath.description: Optional absolute path to AquariusLanguageServer.dll. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

aquarius.trace.server.description: Trace communication with the Aquarius language server.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check scripts/build.js && node --check scripts/publish-server.js && node --test test/manifest.test.js
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run publish-server && npm run compile
